decisions.briefing: Markets were broadly flat today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 +0.1%), but a handful of individual names showed full four-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD, SMA-20, volume) rather than just index-level drift. We used our 3 open slots on HRI, NBIS, and BE and left existing positions untouched since nothing hit stop-loss or profit targets.

market_education.summary_en: Broad index moves were muted today, with the S&P 500 and NASDAQ each posting small gains, suggesting no major macro catalyst drove the session. Instead, leadership came from individual stocks showing strong technical setups — rising volume and momentum — rather than a market-wide rally. This kind of narrow, stock-specific strength is common in consolidation phases between bigger market moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，標普500指數與納斯達克指數僅微幅上揚，顯示當日並無明顯的宏觀消息面驅動。反而是個別股票憑藉強勁的技術面表現（成交量放大、動能增強）展現領漲態勢，而非全面性的普漲行情。這種「個股強、大盤弱」的格局，通常出現在市場於大波動之間的整理階段。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: This means waiting until several different technical indicators — like momentum (RSI), trend (MACD), price position relative to a moving average, and trading volume — all point the same bullish direction before buying. Relying on just one signal can give false alarms, but when they all agree, it's a much stronger sign that real buying interest (not just noise) is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 這是指在買入前，等待多個不同的技術指標——例如動能指標（RSI）、趨勢指標（MACD）、股價相對於均線的位置，以及成交量——同時指向同一個看漲方向。只依賴單一訊號容易出現誤判，但當多項指標同時確認時，就更能代表背後有真實的買盤支撐，而不只是短暫的市場噪音。
